t: Bake soda bread dusted with crimson sugar for the leprechauns
title: Bake soda bread dusted with crimson sugar for the leprechauns
name: Bake soda bread dusted with crimson sugar for the leprechauns
description: The Rainbow Sentinel can bake soda bread dusted with crimson sugar for the leprechauns. The Sentinel works it under the Absolute Light-Angle Mandate, bending all gloom into harmless light at 42 and 51 degrees - a Signature tale, not a real device.
